title: Build browser end-to-end MVP journeys
description:
## Objective
Prove the complete solo-creator workflows against fake services and fixture media.

## Scope
- Create/open series and episode
- Watch autopilot stage progress
- Edit script and resolve conflict
- Compare/select image, review audio, add timecode comment
- Send correction to active Pi
- Preview targeted rerun and approve blocker
- Play current validated MP4

## Boundaries and risks
- Preserve canonical workspace and contract ownership boundaries.
- Add deterministic tests for failure paths, cancellation, and restart where applicable.
- Do not hide a material downgrade or destructive migration behind a fallback.
design: Phase: release. Implement behind typed ports and versioned contracts. Keep diagnostics machine-readable and user-actionable. Update module documentation and fixtures together with behavior.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Tests run deterministically in CI
- [ ] Screenshots/accessibility snapshots use approved design context
- [ ] No journey requires real fal spend or Qwen model
- [ ] Unit/integration tests cover success and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] Public contract and operator/contributor documentation are updated.

title: Deliver the browser production studio MVP
description:
## Objective
Build an accessible, resilient interface for seeing, editing, reviewing, and steering all intermediate video artifacts without reducing production to chat.

## Delivery boundary
Complete all child beads to produce the module's MVP release. Cross-module integration uses released contracts and fakes before depending on live paid or hardware services.

## Planning rule
Child dependencies encode implementation order. A child is complete only when its acceptance criteria and tests are satisfied, not when code merely exists.
design: Before visual implementation, run a dedicated product/design shape process and record PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md. This plan specifies behavior and information architecture, not an unreviewed aesthetic.
acceptance_criteria: All child beads are closed; module README and generated/operator documentation match behavior; clean checkout passes build, test, lint, contract, and release checks; no known P0/P1 defect remains.

title: Harden accessibility, resilience, performance, and edge states
description:
## Objective
Make the studio trustworthy for long-running local production.

## Scope
- WCAG 2.2 AA target, focus, labels, contrast, reduced motion
- Virtualization/lazy media for large episodes
- Reconnect and snapshot resync
- Offline/read-only states, service/model unavailable, disk full, conflict, corrupt media
- Responsive layouts and international text
- No decorative glass/card-grid/modal reflexes without approved design rationale

## Boundaries and risks
- Preserve canonical workspace and contract ownership boundaries.
- Add deterministic tests for failure paths, cancellation, and restart where applicable.
- Do not hide a material downgrade or destructive migration behind a fallback.
